target: RMUC2027 central tower, current synthetic map asset

source_policy.projection_aid: may be used only as a visual aid after checking visibility/occlusion; must be marked and never treated as unconditional truth
source_policy.split_label: each frame carries group_id and exposure state; exposed data cannot be relabeled as sealed

fields.source: run, family/group_id, generation, sequence, capture provenance
fields.target.landmark_id: proposed stable ID such as RMUC2027_CENTRAL_TOWER_PROPOSED
fields.target.ambiguous: boolean; target identity/multiple similar structures uncertain
fields.geometry.bbox_xywh: pixels, origin top-left; only for target present
fields.annotator: agent/user identifier; proxy annotations must say so

rules: bbox and keypoint are in the original image coordinates; model letterbox/flip transforms must be recorded and reversible
reference keypoint is the green roof-light center; if not visible, keypoint is null and reference_status UNAVAILABLE; do not guess
bbox center is not the reference point; never substitute bbox center for the keypoint
absent target must not carry bbox/keypoint
ambiguous identity must set ambiguous=true and be excluded from identity-positive training/evaluation or retained as explicit difficult example
same physical trajectory/reset/static near-identical frames stay in one group
agent annotations are not user expert review; report this limitation

derived_model_format.bbox_normalization: model-specific; source pixels are transformed explicitly

quality_gate.sample_status: 12 exposed development frames; approximate agent labels; QA PASS; not sealed
